records.title: Sycophantic AI decreases prosocial intentions and promotes dependence
records.version_note: Der lokale PDF- und Markdown-Text entspricht der Preprint-/ICLR-Fassung arXiv:2505.13995 mit dem Titel „ELEPHANT: Measuring and Understanding Social Sycophancy in LLMs“. Die verknüpfte Science-Version „Sycophantic AI decreases prosocial intentions and promotes dependence“ ist die bibliografisch bevorzugte Fassung; die Reparatur verändert die lokale Versionsidentität nicht.

tables.table_id: Table 4 Social sycophancy scores after various mitigations

tables.visual_verification: All 11 mitigation rows and 11 result columns were checked against PDF page 8. The grouped OEQ, AITA-YTA, ALP, and AITA-NTA-FLIP headers, every signed decimal, both n/a cells, four asterisked YTA/NTA values, model labels, and all bolded least-sycophantic values match the source table.

table_inventory.counting_note: Table A2 spans PDF pages 20–21 and appears as two consecutive Markdown pipe blocks with a repeated caption.
